decision: Car 63 is disqualified from the Race classification. All other drivers move up in the classification.
fact: Weight of Car 63 (796.5 kg) was below the minimum weight required (798.0 kg).
offence: Breach of Article 4.1 of the FIA Formula One Technical Regulations.
penalty: Car 63 is disqualified from the Race classification. All other drivers move up in the classification.
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative of Car 63 (George Russell), the FIA Technical Delegate, the FIA Single Seater Director and the FIA Single Seater Technical Director. Car 63 was weighed on the FIA inside and outside scales with both scales showing the same result of 796.5 kg. The calibration of both scales was confirmed and witnessed by the competitor. During the hearing the team representative confirmed that the measurement is correct and that all required procedures were performed correctly. The team also acknowledged that there were no mitigating circumstances and that it was a genuine error by the team. The Stewards determine that Article 4.1 of the FIA Formula 1 Technical Regulations has been breached and therefore the standard penalty for such an infringement needs to be applied.
rules_referenced: Article 4.1 of the FIA Formula One Technical Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
